state_semantics.INELIGIBLE: A known policy disqualifier exists. The datum cannot enter the requested learning scope.
state_semantics.QUARANTINED: Required identity, evidence, provenance, time, privacy or runtime-gate truth is absent, ambiguous or conflicting.
state_semantics.CLEARED: This policy's strict admission contract is satisfied for the returned scopes. It is not a dataset seal, model approval or production promotion.

cleared_requires.gates: Every mandatory and domain-specific gate is PASSED and carries non-empty attributable runtime evidence.
cleared_requires.tenant: Explicit tenant_id, valid tenant_scope, resolved identity and no identity conflict.
cleared_requires.evidence: Non-empty evidence/source refs, verified provenance, V2+ verification tier and no unresolved contradiction.
cleared_requires.privacy: Training is explicitly allowed for the requested purpose, legal basis and retention policy exist, and no restriction applies.
cleared_requires.execution: EXECUTED with execution_id and idempotency key.
cleared_requires.outcome: VERIFIED or RECONCILED, mature, and linked to independent verification evidence.
cleared_requires.label: Versioned definition, explicit minimum verification tier, and a source other than CAMBRA_GENERATED_ONLY.
cleared_requires.time: All canonical timestamps are valid; feature availability and recording precede prediction; outcome maturity precedes evaluation.
cleared_requires.cross_tenant: Only an irreversible approved aggregate with cohort_size >= 10, no reidentification mapping and explicit cross-tenant permission.
